title: Terra Luna Classic (LUNC) jumps 17% in a day as Binance carries 41% of trading
dek: LUNC rose about 17% in 24 hours to $0.00004528 early Thursday and climbed CoinGecko's trending list. Binance handled about $14.3 million of the roughly $35 million traded, including $5.6 million in Turkish lira.

title: K3's sBOLD vault hit with 10,000 borrowed wstETH and 9 million new BOLD in one transaction
dek: An attacker hit K3 Capital's sBOLD savings vault on Ethereum on Wednesday morning. In one public transaction it borrowed 10,000 wstETH from Morpho, minted 9 million BOLD, cycled it through the vault and then paid ether to the wallet that built the attack contract.

title: Bitcoin fell to $62,068, and 97 top Hyperliquid traders are 93% short with $694 million
dek: DeepSea counts $693.71 million of bitcoin shorts against $55.60 million of longs among 97 top Hyperliquid traders. With an average short entry of $72,018, the group is well in profit as bitcoin trades near $63,400.

title: Irys jumped 58% in a day as trading volume rose more than 40 times, led by Korean won pairs
dek: IRYS climbed to about $0.025 while bitcoin fell. Daily volume went from about $3.4 million to $161 million, and Upbit's won market carried the most trading, CoinGecko data show.

title: Bitcoin ETFs lost $157.5 million Wednesday, pushing November's outflow to $2.55 billion
dek: U.S. spot bitcoin funds had a second straight outflow day as bitcoin closed near $62,500. Ether funds lost $17 million, their third outflow day in a row.

title: USDT on Plasma jumped 58% in 17 days to $1.09 billion while total USDT shrank
dek: DefiLlama data show USDT on the Plasma chain rose $401 million since November 2, even as total USDT fell $598 million in a week. It is still about 80% below its October 18, 2025, peak of $5.35 billion.

title: USDC on Circle's Arc chain grew $245 million in a week as total USDC shrank $1.1 billion
dek: DefiLlama data put USDC on Arc at $1.60 billion, up 18% in a week and 3.5 times its September low. It is level with Polygon, a hair behind in seventh place among USDC chains.

title: DeepSea's top two traders made $78.7 million in a week but hold just $14.5 million
dek: SMc060 is back at No. 1 on DeepSea's smart money board, with SM6e36 right behind. SM6e36's assets roughly halved in a day while its profit rose, and Arbiscan shows neither wallet keeps any Aave USDC on Arbitrum.

title: One shark pulled $10.2 million of USDC from Aave on Arbitrum in a single trade
dek: An unlabeled wallet made the day's biggest shark sale on any chain, more than 10 times the next one. Arbiscan shows it now holds none of the Aave token, and the pool's supply fell 7% in a day.

title: Pieverse jumps 66% in a day to a record $3.64 as Upbit retakes the lead in trading
dek: PIEVERSE kept climbing after Wednesday morning's high and set another record in the evening while bitcoin and ether fell. Volume nearly quadrupled, and South Korea's Upbit carried 44% of it.

title: Gonka's Ethereum bridge lost $884,000 in USDT in one minute, then 22 million WGNK were minted
dek: A wallet funded six hours earlier set a new key on Gonka's Ethereum bridge, pulled out 884,150 USDT and minted 22 million wrapped GNK on November 18, 2026. The WGNK price fell about 84% by evening.

title: Extended's XTEN airdrop: 300 million tokens, about 4.29 per point, sign by December 31
dek: Perpetuals exchange Extended has set aside 30% of its XTEN token for points holders and opened a signing step in its app. U.S., UK and Canadian users are excluded, and half the supply goes to founders, team and investors.

title: Rumor vs record: Solana 1.0 is real; Zelle's $1.25 million stage transfer is unconfirmed
dek: Solana's London conference set off a wave of posts: Solana 1.0, 150-millisecond finality, Zelle picking Solana, a $1.25 million on-stage transfer and NYSE's owner getting ready for Solana tokens. We checked six claims against official pages and CoinGecko. Three hold up, one is misleading and two cannot be confirmed.

title: Pieverse hits record $2.52, up 132% in 30 days, as PancakeSwap pool takes 37.4% of trading
dek: PIEVERSE beat its November 9 high on Wednesday morning while bitcoin slipped. This time a PancakeSwap pool on BNB Chain, not South Korea's Upbit, handled the largest share of the volume.

title: Momentum (MMT) doubles to $0.25 in a day as trading volume hits 100 times last week's
dek: The token of a Sui-based exchange ran from about $0.12 to $0.25 in 24 hours, with $310 million traded against a $51 million market value. It is still 94% below its 2025 record.

title: Bitcoin ETFs' Tuesday outflow revised to $241.9 million; ether funds lost $26.3 million
dek: Revised CoinMarketCap data show U.S. spot bitcoin funds lost $241.9 million on Tuesday, November 17, not $32.4 million. Ether funds lost $26.3 million instead of taking in $1.3 million.

title: Fake 'USDC' copied an $8.46 million Aave withdrawal to the cent, minutes after it happened
dek: Two big wallets left Aave on Arbitrum on Tuesday. Within minutes, lookalike tokens started writing the same amounts into their histories, and Arbiscan tags the sender as phishing.

title: Smart money trader SMad53 traded $47.6 billion in 30 days. Its open bets total $3.06 million
dek: The No. 6 wallet on DeepSea's 7-day board made $28.57 million in a month after a flat 90 days. It holds 30 small bets, all at 3x, and one bitcoin short makes up 90% of the total.

title: Two sharks pulled $18.5 million of USDC from Aave on Arbitrum in a day. Both now hold none
dek: The No. 2 trader on DeepSea's smart money board took out its last $10.05 million. An unlabeled wallet withdrew $8.46 million. Arbiscan shows both balances at zero.

title: KOL 'tech' bought five PIKA tokens within a second of launch. Each pool now holds under $1
dek: DeepSea logs the BNB Chain wallet buying every new PIKA within one second of launch. DexScreener now shows all five pools with less than $1 of liquidity.

title: SparkLend shrank $447 million in seven days while Maple grew 5.7% in a single day
dek: DefiLlama data show the lender SparkLend fell 10% since November 10 to $4.00 billion, with a $404 million drop in one day. Lender Maple rose to $2.33 billion.

title: Rumor vs record: no official date for Predict.fun's airdrop claim, and no MetaMask token
dek: Posts say PREDICT's delayed Season 1 claim opens November 18 and that a MetaMask token claim closes November 26. We checked four claims against official pages and CoinGecko. Three could not be confirmed on any official page we could open, and one is wrong.

title: $515 million left Hyperliquid's bridge in 8 days. Arbitrum's USDC rose $92 million in a day
dek: DefiLlama data show the Hyperliquid Bridge fell 8.4% since November 9 and USDC on Hyperliquid's chain dropped $194 million in a day. USDC on Arbitrum, Base Bridge and LayerZero gained.

title: Pearl climbed 53% in six days to $1.84 as bitcoin fell. Only 18% of its coins are out
dek: The coin of Pearl, a blockchain that pays GPU miners for AI math, is back on CoinGecko's trending list. Its market value rose by about $184 million in a week, but all 2.1 billion coins would be worth $3.86 billion.

title: Sky's USDS lost $1.63 billion in a month, almost a quarter of its supply
dek: The 12 biggest dollar stablecoins shrank $850 million in a day and $3.61 billion in a week, DefiLlama data show. USDS fell $121 million in a day, and USDC lost ground on Hyperliquid, Solana and Base.

title: Binance opens a $500 million Anthropic IPO token sale, a day after cutting its perp price 13x
dek: Binance Wallet takes USDC orders for Anthropic stock tokens from 1 a.m. to 9 a.m. ET on Wednesday, at an indicative $70 to $78 each. On Tuesday, Binance Futures shrank the price of its Anthropic pre-IPO contract by a factor of 13.116 and renamed it ANTUSDT.

title: infiniFi airdropped 8.3% of INFI on Tuesday. The token is 88% below its first trade
dek: The yield protocol sent INFI straight into eligible wallets on Ethereum and Base on November 17, 2026. Trading opened near $0.92 and slid to about $0.10 by midnight ET, which puts all 100 million tokens at roughly $10.6 million.

title: Bitcoin ETFs took in $9.6 million Monday, ending a 7-day outflow run, then lost $32.4 million
dek: CoinMarketCap's revised data show U.S. spot bitcoin funds took in $9.6 million on Monday, November 16, their first inflow since November 4. On Tuesday they lost $32.4 million as bitcoin dipped below $64,000.

title: Bitway (BTW) bounces 32% in a day, but it is still 84% below its October record
dek: BTW climbed from a low near $0.335 late Monday to about $0.45 on Tuesday evening, after falling more than 60% in a week. A PancakeSwap pool on BNB Chain carried half the trading.

title: Rain (RAIN) has given back 40% since Monday's peak, and HTX carried half the trading
dek: RAIN topped out near $0.0079 early Monday, November 16, then slid to about $0.0048 by Tuesday evening. Only about $20 million traded against a market value of $3.4 billion.

title: Brevis (BREV) doubled in a day from a record low, and 37% of the trading ran through Upbit
dek: BREV hit an all-time low near $0.0554 on Monday night, then ran to about $0.132 by Tuesday morning. It is still about 80% below its January record.

title: Rumor vs record: Hyperliquid Strategies applied for a U.S. futures license. It has not got one
dek: Posts say the Nasdaq-listed HYPE holder got a U.S. futures license after a $620.6 million quarter. We checked each line against its own SEC filing. It applied. It has not been approved.

title: SM7d72 holds $88 million in Ether and bitcoin shorts, $19.2 million up on paper
dek: The No. 3 trader on DeepSea's 7-day board has a $47.6 million Ether short at 25x and a $40.4 million bitcoin short at 40x, plus $55 million in USDC.

title: Sharks sold $37.6 million in 24 hours: one wallet dumped $9.5 million of Aave USDC
dek: DeepSea's 24-hour shark feed shows sells outweighing buys by 3 to 1. The biggest sells are dollar tokens, plus $4.6 million of a Circle-linked token.

title: Smart money wallet SMd4f8 is $3.66 million down on a $6.91 million HYPE short
dek: The No. 12 trader on DeepSea's 7-day board shorted Hyperliquid's HYPE token near $32.46. HYPE now trades near $69, so the bet is deep under water.

title: Injective jumps 12% to $7.48 with no confirmed cause. INJ is still 86% below its record
dek: INJ was one of CoinGecko's trending coins on November 17 with a 12% daily gain. We checked the numbers and found no official announcement that explains it.

title: More bitcoin went onto exchanges than left: net 1,387 BTC in a day, and Binance took 2,479
dek: DeepSea's exchange flow panel shows 20,536 BTC in and 19,148 BTC out. Kraken, Bitfinex and OKX lost coins while Binance and Bybit gained.

title: Marc Zeller's Hyperliquid wallet made $126,600 in a week, two thirds of its 30-day profit
dek: DeepSea ranks the wallet No. 6 on its KOL board. It moved $1.70 million of volume, holds little else, and shows no flags in DeepSea's risk database.

title: A shark with 81,000+ trades a month just bought $6 million of RLUSD, 99% of its basket
dek: DeepSea's shark Hold91cc swapped into 18 tokens within one minute on Ethereum. Only one was big: Ripple's dollar stablecoin.

title: Smart money wallet SM54b0 is all short: $36.5 million in bets, $12.1 million up on paper
dek: The No. 9 trader on DeepSea's 7-day board has ten open Hyperliquid shorts and no long positions. Together they show about $12.1 million of paper profit.

title: Solana ETFs took in $11.7 million on Monday, the most since September, as SOL fell 11%
dek: U.S. spot Solana funds broke a month of selling on November 16, CoinMarketCap data show. XRP funds saw no net flow, and XRP slipped below $1.

title: One shark sold $4.64 million of a Circle stock token worth $8 million in all
dek: One trade by a wallet down $2.93 million in a week was worth more than half of rCRCL's total market value. Another losing shark sold $1.66 million of a SpaceX stock token.

title: Two top-10 traders are short $117.7 million of bitcoin and ether, up $26.6 million on paper
dek: SMdfdb and SM7da2 sit No. 6 and No. 8 on DeepSea's 7-day board. One holds a $55 million ether short from $2,283, the other a $56.3 million bitcoin short from $78,440.

title: HYPE jumped 6% with top traders 91% short. The biggest short is $17.9 million in the red
dek: DeepSea counts $286.5 million of HYPE shorts against $26.8 million of longs among 63 top Hyperliquid traders. The biggest bet against HYPE, opened near $28.79, shows a $17.9 million paper loss.

title: The top two traders' accounts shrank $206 million in two days, and $29.5 million left Aave
dek: SMc060 and SM6e36 still lead DeepSea's 7-day profit board, but the assets DeepSea lists for them fell from $230.8 million to $24.6 million. On Arbitrum, their wallets pulled $29.5 million of USDC out of Aave in a day.

title: Backpack's BP jumped 48% in two hours, then gave back a fifth. Most volume hit Solana pools
dek: BP went from about $0.84 at 4 p.m. ET to about $1.25 at 6 p.m. ET on Monday, CoinGecko data show, and sat near $1.00 after midnight. Daily volume rose about elevenfold.

title: Bitcoin ETFs bled $1.72 billion over seven straight outflow days as bitcoin slid to $65,000
dek: U.S. spot bitcoin funds had a net outflow of $185.4 million on Friday, CoinMarketCap data show, and Monday's figure was revised to a $9.6 million inflow. The seven-day run is their longest in the 63 sessions CoinMarketCap's 90-day chart covers.

title: Lighter's LIT rose 28% from Monday's low, above its price before the $10.4 million loss
dek: LIT traded at $3.00 early Tuesday, CoinGecko data show, about 9% above where it stood before Lighter froze withdrawals. Daily volume is about four times its pre-incident level.

title: PayPal's PYUSD shrank $269 million in a day and is down 22% from its October 27 peak
dek: PYUSD's market value fell 10.2% in 24 hours to $2.38 billion, CoinGecko data show, the biggest one-day drop of any top-30 stablecoin. The price held at $1.

title: Bless (BLESS) more than doubled in a day, and it is still 91% below its 2025 record
dek: BLESS climbed from about $0.0090 to a peak near $0.0194 in 15 hours on Monday, with a single PancakeSwap pool carrying about 41% of the trading.

title: One leaked API key cost a Lighter trader about $10.4 million. Lighter froze all withdrawals
dek: Lighter says a single trader's leaked API key, not a bug in its contracts, let an attacker pull about $10.4 million in USDC on November 16, 2026. On-chain trackers show the money swapped to ether and sent to Hyperliquid.

title: Longs paid on 84% of HYPE futures bets on Friday. Now shorts pay on 61%
dek: HYPE slipped 7.7% in a week to $66.91, and $280 million of its futures bets closed. On Hyperliquid itself traders still pay to bet on a rise, while Binance, Bybit and OKX now show negative funding.

title: Lighter's LIT fell 13% in a day. Shorts now pay on 76% of its $237 million in futures bets
dek: LIT tops CoinGecko's trending list after a 13% drop to $2.61. Futures traded eight times its spot volume, and open bets on Lighter's own LIT market fell 44% in five days.

title: Rumor vs record: MARA's $1.1 billion bitcoin sale came before the crash. 5 claims checked
dek: Monday's most shared posts said MARA dumped $1.1 billion of bitcoin into the slide, that bitcoin is deeply oversold and that big holders face record losses. MARA's own filing and CoinGecko's price records show three claims hold up, one is misleading and one cannot be checked.

title: Ether ETFs lost $2.19 billion in 34 trading days, erasing all their late-summer inflows
dek: U.S. spot ether funds had outflows on 29 of 34 trading days from September 29 to November 13, CoinMarketCap data show. Over 90 days they are now net sellers.

title: USD1 has shrunk 15 days in a row. $833 million is gone since November 1
dek: World Liberty's dollar token fell from $3.87 billion to $3.04 billion on CoinGecko, now below where it started 2026, while it still trades about $1 billion a day.

title: BlackRock's BUIDL shrank 24% in a month and now ranks fourth. Circle's USYC lost 15%
dek: The two big institutional Treasury tokens lost roughly $900 million between them in 30 days, rwa.xyz data show, while Ondo's USDY grew.

title: Ethena's USDtb lost a third in 12 days. USDe added $349 million in one day
dek: Two steps took USDtb from $484 million to $318 million on CoinGecko. Its sister token USDe jumped $349 million in a single reading, then went flat.

title: Influencer mk4 made $4.66 million in a week. The $13.4 million Zcash short is gone
dek: DeepSea now ranks the KOL first on its 7-day board. A week ago mk4 held a big Zcash short; now it bets against ether, bitcoin and Monero and sits mostly in cash.

title: Trader SMeb17 has $2.5 million, made $4.31 million in a week and holds $17.6 million of shorts
dek: DeepSea's SMeb17 is short $12.59 million of ether and $4.97 million of bitcoin on Hyperliquid, about seven times its assets. On Arbitrum, the same address put 1,031 staked ether into Aave.

title: Trader 'John Wick' made $13.1 million in a week and is short $59.8 million of bitcoin
dek: DeepSea ranks the Hyperliquid trader No. 5 on its 7-day smart money board. The bitcoin short, opened near $74,700, shows a $9.3 million paper gain, while most big traders DeepSea tracks are long.

title: Rain (RAIN) jumped 43% in about an hour overnight, and it is still 74% below its August record
dek: RAIN climbed from about $0.0036 to $0.0052 between 12:50 and 1:55 a.m. ET on thin trading, with BingX carrying more than half of the day's volume.

title: Solana ETFs lost $136.7 million in four weeks with only one inflow day
dek: U.S. spot Solana funds saw money leave on 14 of 20 trading days from October 19 to November 13, CoinMarketCap data show. XRP funds lost $19.1 million last week.

title: Jito's staked SOL shrank by 289,349 tokens in a month as its price fell 31%
dek: JitoSOL, Jito's liquid staking token on Solana, ended Sunday at 7.87 million tokens, CoinMarketCap data show. Supply fell on most days of the selloff.

title: Kelp's rsETH lost 10% of its supply in a month. Rocket Pool's rETH fell 3.6%
dek: About 37,900 rsETH tokens were redeemed or burned between October 15 and November 15, CoinMarketCap data show, as ether fell a quarter. Ether.fi's weETH held steady.

title: Lido's stETH grew by 87,688 ETH in a month as ether fell 25%
dek: Holders kept staking through the selloff. Lido's staked ether token reached 9.75 million on Sunday, CoinMarketCap data show, with more than half of the month's growth in the last week.

title: Coinbase's cbBTC added 7,185 bitcoin in a week as bitcoin fell 13%, closing in on WBTC
dek: The supply of Coinbase's wrapped bitcoin token rose to 102,692 by Sunday evening, CoinMarketCap data show. That is about $468 million of new tokens in seven days, and it is closing in on WBTC.

title: Rumor vs record: bitcoin's '3-month low' was its lowest since July. 5 weekend claims checked
dek: Weekend headlines said bitcoin broke $64,000, hit a three-month low and XRP sank to its lowest since 2024. We checked five of them against CoinGecko's price records. Three hold up, one is only partly checked, one cannot be checked.

title: Bitcoin sat flat at $64,749 on Sunday after a 13% weekly drop, and Zcash lost 28%
dek: Bitcoin moved just 0.1% in 24 hours as the crash paused. The seven-day damage stayed deep across the top coins, with Zcash, Uniswap and Pepe down a quarter or more. Quant led the small Sunday bounce.

title: Solana Mobile's SKR jumped 41% in 10 hours, and Korea's Upbit did half the trading
dek: Seeker, the token tied to Solana Mobile, rose from under 1 cent to $0.0122 on Sunday night as daily trading roughly quadrupled. Korean won markets on Upbit and Bithumb carried most of it.

title: EVAA is up 142% in two days, and $60 million traded in a token worth $18 million
dek: The lending token on TON and BNB Chain climbed from $1.10 to $2.67 since early Saturday, with 24-hour trading 3.4 times its market value. Only 13% of its supply circulates, and it is still 80% below its 2025 record.

title: Aster (ASTER) jumped 25% in 55 minutes on Sunday, then lost all of it in 15
dek: ASTER rose from about $0.551 to $0.691 between 3:15 and 4:10 p.m. ET on November 15, then fell to $0.503 by 4:25 p.m. ET. It is now 79% below its record.

title: Bitway (BTW) falls another 27% in a day and is now 81% below its October record
dek: BTW slid from about $0.72 to a low near $0.50 in 24 hours, its second steep daily drop this week, on only about $9.3 million of trading.

title: Meme coin Macca the Gator is up 272% in a day, and all of its trading runs through one Uniswap pool
dek: MACCA, an Ethereum meme token whose CoinGecko price history starts at 2 p.m. ET on November 14, rose from about $0.0046 to a record $0.0190 on Sunday. It is on CoinGecko's trending list.

title: Meme coin AudaCity jumped 260% in 90 minutes after an 85% slide, and it trades in one Uniswap pool
dek: AudaCity (DACITYCOIN), a five-day-old Ethereum meme token, crashed 85% from its record over two days, then rose from $0.0042 to $0.0152 in 90 minutes on Saturday afternoon, November 14. It is up 248% in 24 hours and No. 2 on CoinGecko's trending list.

title: Meme coin Gato The Cat jumped 39% in a day and tops CoinGecko's trending list, all in one Uniswap pool
dek: GATO, a cat-themed Ethereum token whose CoinGecko price history starts on Saturday, November 14, rose 39% in 24 hours to Sunday, November 15, while bitcoin fell 1.8%. Every trade CoinGecko tracks ran through a single Uniswap pool.

title: Meme coin Identity.md jumped 43% in a day as bitcoin fell, all through one Uniswap pool
dek: IMD, an Ethereum meme token with about one day of price history on CoinGecko, rose from about $0.0111 to $0.0159 in 24 hours to Sunday, November 15, and is No. 1 on CoinGecko's trending list. Bitcoin fell 2.0% over the same day.

title: Bitcoin has never lost two years in a row. It needs a 34% jump in 46 days to avoid it
dek: Bitcoin closed 2025 at $87,509 on CoinMarketCap, down 6.3% for the year. At about $65,500 on Sunday, November 15, 2026, it is down 25% in 2026. CoinMarketCap's daily record since 2013 shows every losing year followed by a gain.

title: Polkadot, Filecoin, Algorand and Pi all hit record lows in one Saturday evening
dek: As bitcoin slid on Saturday, November 14, 2026, Polkadot's DOT, Filecoin's FIL, Algorand's ALGO and Pi Network's PI all set all-time lows on CoinGecko within about three and a half hours. Each is now 97% to 99.7% below its peak.

title: Rumor vs record: bitcoin broke its 200-week average, but not for the first time
dek: After bitcoin's weekend slide, posts claimed a first-ever break of the 200-week average, a record fear reading and an 18% loss for Strategy. We checked five claims against CoinMarketCap, CoinGecko and Strategy's own filing.

title: Solana fell 19% in a week. Shorts now pay on 83% of its $4.2 billion in futures bets
dek: Funding on Solana perpetual futures was negative on almost every big venue, CoinGecko's derivatives data show. XRP looks similar. Bitcoin does not, and on Hyperliquid, Solana longs still pay.

title: SEC lets Nasdaq ISE list crypto ETF options without a vote per fund, if coins pass a $700 million test
dek: A November 10 SEC order lets the options exchange list contracts on trusts that hold "digital commodities" without a new SEC vote for each fund. Each coin inside must pass a size test, and most of the fund a surveillance test.

title: Seven big dollar tokens shrank $3.46 billion in under a week. Only RLUSD grew
dek: USDT and USDC lost $2.82 billion between them since Sunday, November 8, CoinGecko data show, as bitcoin fell 13.6% in seven days. Ripple's RLUSD added $107 million.

title: Gold token PAXG is 32% off its January record, yet holders added 16,200 ounces since August
dek: PAX Gold fell 5.7% in a week to $3,826, CoinGecko data show. Its supply, one token per ounce, rose to 447,522 ounces, up 16,209 since its August 29 low.

title: Paxos's Global Dollar shrank $512 million in 24 days, 16% of its supply
dek: USDG fell from $3.16 billion on October 22 to $2.65 billion on Sunday, CoinGecko data show. That is 25% below its May peak, while its price held at $1.

title: Sharks sold $47.6 million of dollar tokens in a day and bought $40.4 million
dek: DeepSea's 24-hour shark lists show 18 stablecoin and dollar-yield token rows in 492 trades. That is a net $7.28 million out, led by Aave USDC on Arbitrum and AUSD on Monad.

title: Two traders made $147.7 million in crash week. Their Arbitrum wallets moved $55 million in a day
dek: DeepSea's smart money board shows SMc060 up $80.36 million and SM6e36 up $67.36 million in 7 days. On Arbitrum, the same addresses sold $30 million and bought $25 million of tokens in a day, sums that match Aave's USDC deposit token.

title: Binance's Anthropic pre-IPO contract assumed 1 billion shares. The filing points to 13.1 billion
dek: Binance priced its ANTHROPICUSDT contract on an estimate of 1 billion Anthropic shares. Citing Anthropic's latest IPO filing, it now expects about 13.1 billion and will resize and rename the contract before the stock lists.

title: Binance reopens withdrawals on 87 more networks after covering its $6.34 billion hack
dek: Two weeks after the October 29 theft, Binance says it has covered every affected asset with company money and reopened withdrawals on 87 more networks, from Avalanche to Cardano. It aims to reopen the rest by the end of next week.

title: U.S. bitcoin ETFs lost $881 million in a week and $1.72 billion in seven straight days
dek: U.S. spot bitcoin funds had net outflows every trading day from November 5 to 13 while bitcoin fell 8.6% over the week. Ether funds ended a six-day losing run with a $2.3 million inflow on Friday.

title: Ether fell to $1,714 on Saturday, below $1,800 for the first time since July
dek: Ether fell below $1,900 late Friday and $1,800 on Saturday afternoon, then hit $1,714.75 at 8:45 p.m. ET, CoinGecko data show. That is its lowest price since early July, and ether has lost 18.9% in a week.

title: Rumor vs record: bitcoin hit $62,081, and only 3 of 7 viral crash claims hold up
dek: Bitcoin's Saturday slide set off a wave of posts about record ETF exits, a 50% crash and a hidden fund blowup. We checked seven of the most shared claims against CoinGecko, CoinMarketCap and ETF flow data.

title: Hyperliquid passes Bybit to rank third in open bets, even as its crypto bets shrank 14%
dek: Hyperliquid now ranks third for open futures bets, even though bets on its crypto markets fell about $590 million from Friday to early Sunday as bitcoin slid to $64,800. Bets on stocks, indexes and commodities held near $2.16 billion, CoinGecko data show.

title: Uniswap's UNI lost 29% in a week. DEX tokens fell 9.9% in a day, three times bitcoin's drop
dek: Tokens of automated market makers, the pool-based exchanges behind most DeFi trading, lost 9.9% of their value in 24 hours to early Sunday. Bitcoin fell 3%. CoinGecko data show UNI, Curve and Aerodrome leading the slide.

title: One Arbitrum wallet sent out $36.4 million of EVA in a day, but DEXes traded just $80,000
dek: DeepSea's 24-hour feed shows one unlabeled wallet sending out about 1 million EverValueCoin in 11 moves. The token's DEX pools could never have absorbed that as a sale.

title: OP fell 9.6% in a day. Optimism sharks still bought $2.58 million and sold $2.38 million
dek: Big wallets on OP Mainnet ended the day as small net buyers of OP and WLD while both tokens slid. Most of them are still losing money this week.

title: 98 sharks lost $15.7 million in a week. Two BNB Chain wallets lost $5.3 million of it
dek: Only 27 of 98 big wallets in DeepSea's live feed closed the week with a profit, and the winners made just $101,900 together. BNB Chain and Ethereum took the worst hits.

title: Uniswap's UNI falls 16% in a day to $4.77 as bitcoin drops 8% to its lowest since July
dek: UNI slid from about $5.70 to $4.77 between Friday and Saturday evening, its lowest level since late August, and is down 33% in a week. Bitcoin fell from about $68,240 to $62,720 and ether lost about 10% over the same 24 hours.

title: Aster's ASTER drops 21% in 80 minutes to $0.48 while bitcoin slips about 2%
dek: ASTER drifted near $0.62 for most of Saturday, then fell from about $0.61 at 2:35 p.m. ET to a low near $0.483 at 3:55 p.m. ET on November 14. Trading volume more than doubled and the token jumped onto CoinGecko's trending list.

title: Kava's KAVA falls 47% in two hours to a record low near $0.036
dek: KAVA sat flat near $0.068 for two days, then broke down at 5:05 a.m. ET on November 14 and hit an all-time low of about $0.0356 before 7 a.m. ET. Prices on Korea's Upbit and Bithumb stayed far above the rest of the market.

title: A $128.7 million wallet sold $677,000 of ASTER and bought $991,000 of USDT0 as bitcoin slid
dek: The address has no public label on DeepSea. DeepSea saw it trade on four networks in a day, cut ASTER and ARB, and win 28% of its trades in 30 days.

title: USDT0 added $115 million in a day, most since May. Sharks bought $2.57 million on Optimism
dek: Tether's cross-chain token grew while USDT shrank, CoinGecko data show. DeepSea's data show large wallets swapping into it on Optimism and Berachain, and out of it on Unichain.

title: Ripple's RLUSD hit $2.79 billion, its highest in a year, up $83 million in a day. USDT shrank $323 million
dek: While bitcoin slid and the biggest stablecoin lost supply, Ripple's dollar token kept growing, CoinGecko data show. DefiLlama counts a much smaller total.

title: Falcon's USDf shrank $104 million in a day, its biggest one-day drop since at least May
dek: The synthetic dollar lost 5.7% of its market value in 24 hours as bitcoin slid, CoinGecko data show. It still trades just under $1, as it has for months.

title: A Monad wallet bought $1 million of MetaMask's mUSD in an hour and traded $167 million in 30 days
dek: DeepSea counts 13,802 mUSD trades by one Monad shark in a month, more mUSD bought than DefiLlama counts on all of Monad. Who runs it is unknown.

title: Rumor vs record: XRP fell below $1. 3 of 7 viral claims hold up, 3 cannot be checked
dek: XRP slipped under $1 late Friday and posts about it spread fast. We checked seven of the most shared claims against CoinGecko's price record. Three are true, one is partly true and three cannot be checked.

title: CFTC sued Arkansas and Louisiana in one day. Arkansas seeks up to $10,000 per Kalshi violation
dek: On November 13, 2026, the U.S. derivatives regulator said it had sued Arkansas and Louisiana to stop state actions against federally regulated prediction markets. Arkansas is the 11th state it has taken to court.

title: Bitcoin hit $66,492, its lowest since August 19. Solana and HYPE fell twice as fast
dek: Bitcoin set a new low for this slide overnight, $1,430 under the low in our Friday report, and is down 11.5% in a week, CoinGecko data show. Solana, Hyperliquid's HYPE and ether all fell to levels last seen in mid-August, and XRP slipped below $1.

title: Pearl rose 18% in a day while bitcoin slipped. It is still 37% below its October record
dek: The token of Pearl, a blockchain that pays GPU miners for AI math, climbed from about $1.31 to $1.55 in 24 hours to Saturday, November 14, and is on CoinGecko's trending list. Bitcoin fell 1.6% over the same day.

title: AKE rose 82% more after our Friday report as $583 million traded, twice its value
dek: Akedo's AKE token rose another 82% from Friday morning to early Saturday and is up almost fourfold from its 24-hour low, CoinGecko data show. It is still 92% below its September record.

title: One wallet took in $32.8 million of ARB in a week as ARB fell 14.5%. DeepSea shows $0 sent
dek: A large Arbitrum wallet kept receiving ARB from four addresses and bought more, DeepSea's data show, through one of the token's weakest weeks. Who owns it is unknown, and we could not check it on a block explorer.

title: Two tokens named ni hao cat: one fell 90% overnight, then jumped 9x in a day
dek: CoinGecko lists two "ni hao cat" tokens with the same MIHAO ticker, one on Ethereum and one on Solana. The Ethereum one went from a record to a 90% loss and back up 9x in 24 hours, all in a single Uniswap pool.

title: HYPE rose 4% as bitcoin fell 5%. Longs pay on 84% of its $2.6 billion in futures bets
dek: Hyperliquid's token was the best performer among CoinGecko's 50 largest coins on the day bitcoin fell below $70,000. Futures traders kept betting on it to rise, and on Hyperliquid itself HYPE bets now outweigh ether's.

title: USDC shrank $361 million in a day as bitcoin fell below $70,000. USD1 lost 2%
dek: The 20 biggest stablecoins lost $559 million in value in 24 hours, and Circle's USDC was most of it, CoinGecko data show. Tether's USDT barely moved this time, while a few smaller dollar tokens grew.

title: Nvidia bets traded $1.95 billion on Hyperliquid in a day, more than ether, as bitcoin fell
dek: In the 24 hours to 6:38 a.m. ET Friday, the day after Nvidia announced its CEO's exit, its main perpetual market on Hyperliquid outtraded ether's and trailed only bitcoin's. Stock and commodity markets now hold 35% of the exchange's open bets, CoinGecko data show.

title: Bitcoin fell below $70,000. Shorts now pay longs on 60% of its $43.7 billion in futures bets
dek: Funding turned negative on seven of the ten biggest bitcoin perpetual markets as the price fell 5% in a day, CoinGecko data show. Solana bets leaned even harder toward a fall. XRP and zcash bets did not.

title: A $101 million shark lost $1.21 million in a week, then sold 11 altcoins in two minutes
dek: Hold91cc, an Ethereum wallet we have followed since November 8, now trades about $1.24 billion a month. Its 30-day result has turned to a $1.14 million loss.

title: Two Hyperliquid traders made $111.7 million in the week bitcoin fell below $70,000
dek: DeepSea's smart money board puts SMc060 at +$57.45 million and SM6e36 at +$54.30 million over 7 days. Together they hold 60% of the top 10's gains.

title: Sharks' weekly loss quadrupled to $10.5 million. Yesterday's top wallet is down $1.35 million
dek: In about 30 hours, DeepSea's 7-day table went from minus $2.56 million to minus $10.50 million for big traders. The best wallet this time made just $121,574.

title: A shark sold 29.17 million WLD for $8.49 million in one trade as bitcoin fell below $70,000
dek: An Optimism wallet that DeepSea tags as a shark dumped about 0.78% of all circulating WLD overnight. Its closed trades are down $2.83 million in 30 days.

title: Akedo's AKE jumped 151% in a day. It is still 95% below its September record
dek: An AI game-making token on BNB Chain traded more than its own market value in 24 hours while bitcoin fell. Less than a quarter of its supply is circulating.

title: Rumor vs record: 7 viral claims about bitcoin's fall below $70,000, checked
dek: Posts about Friday's crypto drop spread fast: a first since August, a 45% fall from the record, $1.2 billion liquidated, Nvidia to blame. We checked seven claims against price data and official records.

title: Bitcoin fell below $70,000 for the first time since August. Ether dropped under $2,000
dek: Bitcoin fell to $67,922 and ether to $1,905 overnight, the lowest since mid-August, and the crypto market lost 6.8% of its value in a day. Rate fears and fund outflows built up all week.

title: Bitway (BTW) drops 29% in a day, now 74% below its October record
dek: BTW fell from $1.06 to about $0.71 in 24 hours on thin volume of about $7.3 million, with Gate handling more than a third of the trading.

title: BlackRock's IBIT shed 22.7 million shares in four sessions as bitcoin fell to $68,393
dek: iShares data shows IBIT's share count down 1.6% since November 6, roughly $919 million at Thursday's NAV. Bitcoin lost 7% in 24 hours.

title: Ether fell 14% in a week, yet 912,000 ETH is waiting in line to be staked
dek: Ethereum's entry queue holds 3.5 times more ether than its exit queue, Validator Queue data show. SharpLink's labeled wallet staked another 128 ETH on November 12 as the price slid.

title: One company sold its last 211 bitcoin at $76,000. Strategy bought 1,036 at $79,012
dek: Hyperscale Data says it has sold all its bitcoin, about 1,113 BTC since July. Strategy kept buying, but spent more than twice as much buying back its own preferred stock. Bitcoin now trades at $68,521.

title: Rumor vs record: Nvidia says Huang resigned but gives no reason. Was he ousted?
dek: Nvidia announced its CEO's resignation on November 12, 2026, and crypto feeds filled with claims about why and what it did to prices. We checked six of them against Nvidia's own filing.

title: KPMG counted Tether Gold's bars: 520,089 ounces for 520,089 tokens
dek: Tether says KPMG gave Tether Gold (XAU₮) a clean audit for 2025, its second Big Four audit after USDT. The gold matched the tokens almost to the ounce.

title: USDT shrank $2.69 billion in 8 days, but Tether's Ethereum treasury still holds $4.65 billion
dek: Etherscan shows 4.65 billion USDT parked in the wallet it labels Tether: Treasury, which kept sending tokens out through November 12. CoinGecko counts $5.47 billion of USDT as not circulating.

title: Fed's Waller set a 0.3% test for a half-point hike. October's core CPI hit it
dek: Fed Governor Christopher Waller said a 25 basis point hike in December could hurt the Fed's credibility if core inflation stayed near 0.3%. Hours later, October's core reading came in at 0.3%.

title: US moves to seize $1.2 billion of the Binance hack haul and shuts down North Korea's deepfake call trap
dek: The Justice Department says it won court approval to seize or restrain more than $1.2 billion stolen from Binance on October 29. It also took down servers behind "FaceStealer," a fake video call scheme it ties to more than $400 million in thefts.

title: 64 of 90 bitcoin treasury companies are below cost at $72,857, Strategy by $2.21 billion
dek: At $72,857 a coin, the public companies that report what they paid for bitcoin hold $3.01 billion less than they spent, CoinGecko's treasury tracker shows. Ether holders look worse: 14 of 15 are under water.

title: ARB fell 8% after one wallet's $3.17 million buy. Shorts now pay on 79% of its futures bets
dek: Sharks bought $3.65 million of Arbitrum's ARB in a day and sold $9,135, DeepSea's data show. The price kept sliding, and on most futures markets traders betting on a fall now pay those betting on a rise.

title: Bitcoin Core discloses 3 bugs fixed in 2025. The worst could stop a node building blocks
dek: Bitcoin Core published three security advisories on November 10, one rated high. All were fixed in releases from October 2025, and the advisories describe no theft of coins.

title: U.S. bitcoin ETFs lost $1.49 billion in five straight days as bitcoin fell 9%
dek: Spot bitcoin funds have now seen money leave on eight of the last nine trading days, $2.57 billion in all, CoinMarketCap's tally shows. Ether funds lost $477 million in the same five days.

title: MEET48's IDOL rose 65% and halved in under 16 hours. Futures traded 16 times spot
dek: The small BNB Chain token jumped from $0.024 to $0.040 on Wednesday evening and was back below $0.020 by dawn. Open futures bets on it are worth more than the token's whole market value.

title: PEPE fell 11% in a day. Shorts now pay longs on half of its $465 million in futures bets
dek: The frog memecoin was the worst performer among the 50 biggest coins on CoinGecko. Its open futures bets equal about a quarter of its market value, and on the biggest market, Binance's, shorts now pay longs.

title: PayPal's PYUSD shrank $136 million in a day and $377 million since its October 27 peak
dek: The PayPal dollar token lost 4.9% of its market value in 24 hours, CoinGecko data show, while Ripple's RLUSD and the Global Dollar held steady. Its price never left $1.

title: Rumor vs record: MSCI's cut makes funds sell Strategy shares, not Strategy's bitcoin
dek: After MSCI dropped Strategy from its USA index, posts warned of $2.8 billion to $8.8 billion in "forced selling" and asked what it means for bitcoin. We checked four claims against MSCI's own documents and Strategy's latest SEC filing.

title: A shark lost $4.03 million on 7 trades in a week, then bought $468,070 of a SpaceX token
dek: A single BNB Chain wallet now accounts for more than half of the sharks' net loss on DeepSea's 7-day table. In the past day, the same address spent nearly half a million dollars on a SpaceX stock token on Arbitrum.

title: A shark lost $1.21 million on four chains in a week, then sold $1.36 million on Optimism
dek: The wallet DeepSea calls Hold1f17 shows realized losses on all four chains it traded this week. In the last 24 hours it also made the largest sell-only move of any shark.

title: Two Avalanche wallets made 3,121 trades in a day, five times Monday's pace, and ended near even
dek: DeepSea's shark table shows $4.86 million of bridged ether and bitcoin bought on Avalanche and $4.72 million sold. Almost all of it came from the same two wallets, swapping back and forth.

title: Bitcoin fell 8.5% in a week, XRP 20%, zcash 25%. Sharks did not dump bitcoin or ether
dek: CoinGecko's 7-day numbers show the big coins sliding together. DeepSea's 24-hour shark table shows big wallets near flat on bridged bitcoin and ether, buying ARB and WLD and selling OP.

title: OKX and NYSE owner ICE open 24/7 tokenized stock trading on November 23, with 70+ assets
dek: OKX says its joint venture with Intercontinental Exchange, OKXICE, starts trading tokenized US securities around the clock on November 23 under a temporary SEC exemption. OKB rose about 5% from Tuesday noon to Wednesday morning ET.

title: Sharks sold $3.64 million of OP in a day, $1.3 million more than they bought
dek: DeepSea's 24-hour table puts Optimism's own token at the top of shark selling across every chain it tracks. OP is down 12.5% in a week on CoinGecko and 98% below its record.

title: 75 of 102 shark wallets lost money this week. One BNB Chain wallet made $967,000
dek: DeepSea's 7-day profit table shows big traders down $2.56 million on closed trades, winning one trade in three. A single wallet made 80% of all the gains.

title: Deutsche Bank custody site says bitcoin, ether and 3 stablecoins are available in Germany
dek: Germany's largest bank says its digital asset custody is available to Corporate Bank clients in Germany. Retail customers are not part of it.

title: Rumor vs record: will an "ANT" Anthropic stock token go live on Solana on IPO day?
dek: A viral post says a tokenized Anthropic share called ANT will launch on Solana the day Anthropic starts trading in public. CoinGecko does list an Anthropic xStock with a Solana address, but under a different ticker, with zero supply and no price. We found no Anthropic or issuer statement that sets a date.

title: Stablecoins lost $13.4 billion in 30 days. USDT alone shrank $8.3 billion
dek: CoinGecko data shows the three biggest dollar tokens all got smaller since mid-October. Tether's USDT fell every week, and November 11 was its worst day of the month.

title: One wallet bought $3.17 million of ARB in one trade, a day after its $3.29 million CHIP buy
dek: DeepSea's 24-hour table shows Arbitrum sharks bought $3.65 million of ARB and sold $771. Most of it came from one wallet that Etherscan shows holding 135 million ARB.

title: Only 89 of 210 KOL wallets made money in 30 days. Top earner kurtz won 11 of 11
dek: DeepSea's realized PnL table shows most tracked influencer wallets lost money over 30 days, yet the group is up $374,000 as a few big winners carried the total.

title: MSCI cuts Strategy, owner of 850,364 bitcoin, from its USA index after November 30
dek: MSCI's November review list names "Strategy A" among 24 deletions from the MSCI USA Index. Funds that copy the index will have to sell the stock by the close of November 30.

title: Initia's INIT falls 71% from its day high to $0.113, below where its rally began
dek: INIT touched $0.392 in the past 24 hours, then slid to about $0.113 by 10:05 p.m. ET on November 11. That is lower than its price before the November 9 surge, with traders swapping three times its market value in a day.

title: SEC cases fall to 348 from 456 as crypto examples include a $95.6 million mining fraud
dek: The SEC's fiscal 2026 enforcement results, released November 10, show 348 actions and $1.095 billion in ordered money. The crypto cases it highlights are retail frauds, from a $14 million fake platform scheme to an FTX audit case.

title: 21 REX-Osprey altcoin ETFs get a new start date, November 20, after 13 months of waiting
dek: An October 22 SEC filing pushes back the effective date for 21 planned REX-Osprey funds, from AAVE to XLM. Most of their tokens fell 15% to 38% in the past 30 days.

title: Midnight's NIGHT airdrop thaw ends December 4. The last 25% installments are landing now
dek: NIGHT claimed in the Glacier Drop and Scavenger Mine unlocks in four 25% steps, and Midnight says the whole thaw ends December 4, 2026. NIGHT trades 64% below its record.

title: Rumor vs record: is a hacker really selling 335.9 million Binance user records?
dek: A "pay or leak" ad offering 335.9 million Binance records, private keys included, has been reshared online. We checked each claim against Binance's own pages and a threat intelligence firm's review. Nothing confirms it, and its headline number is close to a counter anyone can read on Binance's homepage.

title: US prices rose 0.4% in October, with no yearly inflation rate. Bitcoin fell 1.4% on the day
dek: October's consumer price index, out November 10, slowed from September's 0.6% jump. The Labor Department could not publish the usual 12-month rate because it collected no data in October 2025. Bitcoin dipped about 0.6% in 20 minutes around the release and ended the day near $73,650.

title: Grayscale's Hyperliquid ETF staked 90% of its $197 million, earning 10,341 HYPE in a quarter
dek: The quarterly report of Grayscale Hyperliquid Staking ETF (HYPG), filed with the SEC on November 10, shows 2.22 million HYPE in the fund on September 30 and a $48.3 million quarterly gain. HYPE has since dropped about 19%.

title: Stablecoins shrank $1.25 billion in a day. USDT and USDC on Ethereum fell $1.06 billion
dek: The eight biggest dollar stablecoins lost $1.25 billion in 24 hours and $4.86 billion in a week, DefiLlama data show. Ethereum and Hyperliquid shed the most, while USDC grew on Solana, Arbitrum and Base and USDT grew on Plasma.

title: Lighter's LIT rose 10%, and Hyperliquid holds more LIT bets than Lighter itself
dek: LIT climbed to $3.47 while Lighter's fees held near $260,000 a day on DefiLlama. Rival Hyperliquid carries $61.4 million of open LIT bets, against $39.1 million on Lighter's own market.

title: Zcash fell 12% to $1,015. Hyperliquid lost 57% of its open Zcash bets in a day
dek: ZEC dropped from about $1,160 to $1,015 in 24 hours. On Hyperliquid, open interest in the ZEC perpetual fell from $486.8 million to $211.3 million, CoinGecko data show, the steepest cut of any big venue.

title: A Monad shark put $3.6 million into earnAUSD, a fifth of the yield token's market value
dek: The busiest shark on Monad bought $16 million of tokens in a day, mostly dollar tokens. Its biggest one-way bet was a yield version of AUSD that CoinGecko values at $17.7 million.

title: Optimism sharks lost $293,000 in a week, 20 of 24 in the red, yet bought $1.41 million of WLD
dek: DeepSea's PnL table shows a bad week for big wallets on OP Mainnet. In the last day they bought more WLD than they sold and sold more OP than they bought.

title: The week's top shark made $1.52 million on 3,619 trades, then sold $369,000 of BTCB
dek: The BNB Chain wallet that bought $5.4 million of ether three days ago leads every wallet in DeepSea's 7-day profit table. At 12:34 a.m. ET it sold 5 BTCB in one trade.

title: One wallet bought 5% of all circulating CHIP in a single $3.29 million trade
dek: DeepSea logged an $18.4 million Arbitrum shark wallet buying USD.AI's CHIP token as it traded 50% below its price of a month ago. Arbiscan shows the wallet now holds 100 million CHIP.

title: Kinetiq's KNTQ fell 25% in a day and now trades at half its October 30 record
dek: The token of Hyperliquid staking project Kinetiq slid from about $0.40 to $0.30 in two sharp drops on Tuesday, November 10, while HYPE and bitcoin moved less than 3%. More than half of the trading ran through Hyperliquid's own spot market, CoinGecko data shows.

title: Canada proposes barring banks from issuing stablecoins directly. Subsidiaries only
dek: Budget 2026 proposes to bar federally regulated banks, trust companies and insurers from issuing stablecoins themselves. They would have to use a separate non-financial subsidiary that the Bank of Canada supervises.

title: BitMine bought 9,587 more ether, but its staking income estimate fell $49 million in a week
dek: BitMine Immersion now reports 6,070,092 ETH. It staked no new coins this week, its yield estimate slipped, and ether's drop since its count has cut about $870 million off the pile's value.

title: Sharks bought $36.4 million of RLUSD in a day. Over the week, whales sold $12 million net
dek: Two wallets made 37 trades in Ripple's stablecoin in 24 hours. One of them, with $97 million on DeepSea, swaps it in blocks of up to $4.5 million.

title: Sharks sold $19 million of gold tokens in a day, a day after buying $8.1 million of XAUt
dek: A handful of big wallets sold $10.5 million of PAXG and $8.5 million of Tether Gold and bought back $2.8 million. Both tokens slipped about 0.9%.

title: 23 influencer wallets bought $555,000 of two new memecoins in a day. No priced sales
dek: The same 23 BNB Chain KOL wallets piled into 狗狗币 and spyless within about two hours. CoinGecko does not list either token.

title: Smart money trader SMffa1 made $13.8 million in a week, 40% of its $34.3 million wallet
dek: DeepSea ranks SMffa1 No. 3 on Hyperliquid this week. At 6:45 a.m. ET its live trades were in stock-price markets such as LITE, SKHY and SOXL, not crypto.

title: Super Inu (SI) jumps 164% in a day, a week after a 97% crash
dek: The Ethereum meme coin traded near $0.016 early Tuesday, about 23 times its November 5 low, yet still 45% below its October 31 record. Almost all trading runs through one Uniswap pool.

title: Janction (JCT) gives back most of its rally: down 65% from Sunday's record
dek: JCT hit an all-time high near $0.0185 on Sunday afternoon. By early Tuesday it traded near $0.0065, down 26% in a day, though still more than twice its price before the surge.

title: Rumor vs record: a viral post credited to Musk said Binance holds 80% of crypto. It does not
dek: A viral post credited to Elon Musk said Binance holds about 80% of the crypto market and urged users to leave. We checked each line against CoinGecko's exchange data and DeepSea's wallet tracker. The 80% figure does not hold up.

title: Zcash fell 9% in two days. Open bets on its six biggest futures markets fell 40%
dek: ZEC slid from $1,279 to about $1,160 since November 8. Over the same stretch, open interest on Hyperliquid, OrangeX, CoinW, Gate, OKX and Bybit dropped from $2.51 billion to $1.50 billion, CoinGecko data show.

title: Initia's INIT jumped about 70% in a day, and traders swapped twice its market value
dek: INIT climbed from about $0.12 to $0.22 in 24 hours, with $98 million to $102 million of trading against a market value under $50 million. Binance carried 43% of it, and a Turkish lira pair led every market.

title: Coinbase's cbBTC gained 2,921 bitcoin in 30 days. Lombard's LBTC lost 39% of its supply
dek: Bitcoin is leaving most wrapped tokens on other chains, CoinGecko supply data shows. Coinbase's version was the exception, until it gave back 891 BTC in a day.

title: Hyperliquid's oil market fell 7% and a chip-stock market rose 21%. Crypto bets shrank $420M
dek: Hyperliquid's crypto markets held $9.18 billion of open bets, down from $9.60 billion a day earlier. Its stock and commodity markets now hold a third of the total.

title: World Liberty's USD1 shrank 22% in 30 days, and USDC lost another $205 million on Monday
dek: USD1 fell from $4.26 billion to $3.32 billion in a month, CoinGecko data shows. USDC kept leaking too, while USDT held flat for a second day.

title: A $93 million shark made 28,847 trades in 30 days, lost $162,000 and doubled its gold
dek: Two days ago Hold91cc was up $26,100 on 12,787 trades. Now it has more than twice the trades, a loss, $18.77 million in Tether Gold and a $173,000 AAVE sale.

title: Smart money SM2b00 made $22 million on $13.29 billion of trades. Now it holds 15 shorts
dek: SM2b00 is No. 4 on DeepSea's 7-day board at +$10.26 million. Its biggest bets are against ETH, SOL and HYPE, and CoinGecko prices show most of them in profit.

title: Influencer panceramic sold $351,000 of silver bets in 20 orders and went all cash
dek: DeepSea shows 20 silver sell orders on Hyperliquid, then a wallet of $353,200 in USDC and no open bets. Ninety percent of the influencer's 30-day profit came this week.

title: Hong Kong moves to ban "crypto exchange" in the names of unlicensed firms
dek: The Securities and Futures Commission has concluded its consultation on misleading business names. Any firm calling itself a crypto exchange, virtual asset market or token trading platform would need SFC approval first, six months after the law passes.

title: Allora's first cliff unlocks 160 million ALLO on November 11, about 38% of circulating supply
dek: One year after launch, Allora's schedule frees a third of the tokens held by early backers and core contributors. At CoinGecko's price on November 9, that is about $23.6 million of new supply against a $62 million market cap.

title: The SEC's crypto capital and records rule for brokers reached the White House on November 3
dek: A proposed SEC rule on how broker-dealers hold capital and keep records for crypto assets reached the White House regulatory office on November 3, 2026. The text is still private. Staff guidance shows where the agency has been heading.

title: Last week's worst crypto influencer is now No. 2 and holds a $13.4 million Zcash short
dek: The KOL wallet mk4 was down $2.84 million for the week on November 5. DeepSea now shows +$2.24 million over seven days, but still minus $876,800 over 30.

title: The No. 1 smart money trader is short $474 million of crypto and up $45.7 million on paper
dek: SMc060 retook first place on DeepSea's 7-day board with +$36.67 million. Its 19 open bets against BTC, ETH, ZEC and others are all in profit on paper.

title: Sharks sold $584,000 of ARB in a day, nearly 4 to 1, as the token edged up 1.1%
dek: Four days after shark wallets bought $850,000 of Arbitrum's token, the flow reversed. One wallet also sold tokenized Circle shares in the last hour.

title: Unichain sharks sold $2.12 million of USD₮0, three days after sharks bought $3.74 million
dek: The flow on Unichain's dollar token flipped. A wallet that was not among Friday's buyers did almost all the selling.

title: One Monad shark made 267 of 268 trades in a day. Its 30-day loss grew to $1.35 million
dek: One wallet made almost every shark trade DeepSea tracked on Monad, cycling $7.1 million through two dollar tokens. Its losses keep growing.

title: Two Avalanche shark wallets made 580 small trades in bridged ETH and BTC as AVAX rose 8%
dek: DeepSea's Avalanche shark feed looked crowded on Monday night. It was mostly two wallets swapping bridged ether and bitcoin back and forth in small pieces.

title: Pieverse (PIEVERSE) doubles in a week to a record $2.13 as Upbit leads trading
dek: PIEVERSE rose 42% in 24 hours and 103% in seven days to a new all-time high on Monday. Upbit and Bithumb, two won-based exchanges, handled more than half of the $58.7 million traded.

title: Ether's 5% drop cut about $956 million from the 8.1 million ETH that public companies hold
dek: CoinGecko lists 35 public companies with ether on their books, 32 with a balance. BitMine holds 74% of it, and 14 of the 15 firms with a listed cost are below it.

title: 429 sharks traded LINK in a day, triple any other Ethereum token, buying $14.1 million
dek: Chainlink's token was the most crowded shark trade on Ethereum as ether fell 5%. Uniswap's UNI drew under a third as many wallets, and they were net sellers.

title: Nigeria sets a ₦15 billion floor for dollar stablecoin issuers and bans algorithmic coins
dek: The Central Bank of Nigeria's new rules say foreign-currency stablecoins can reach Nigerians only through a locally licensed issuer. A foreign license does not count, and peer-to-peer desks need the bank's approval.

title: Trader SMb7ae made $11.5 million in a week, and 18 of its 20 open bets are shorts
dek: SMb7ae is No. 5 on DeepSea's 7-day Smart Money board. Its open positions on Hyperliquid bet against bitcoin, HYPE, Starknet and 15 other tokens.

title: 80 sharks bought $8.1 million of Tether's gold token as ether fell 5%, while PAXG was sold
dek: While ether dropped 5%, large wallets on DeepSea's live feed piled into XAUt. The rival gold token, PAXG, went the other way.
